description: Recorded real NOAA National Hurricane Center Peak Storm Surge products. Nothing is synthetic; the KML is NHC's archived advisory file byte-verbatim (stored gzip-compressed), and the query JSON is the live ArcGIS response byte-verbatim.
source: NOAA National Hurricane Center, https://www.nhc.noaa.gov. US Government work, public domain.
notes: Used by tests/test_storm_surge_source.py. The Peak Storm Surge product covers the US Gulf and Atlantic coasts, Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands; outside an active advisory the live service serves zero features, which the empty-query fixture records.
